rows.notes: The study is a narrative review of AI applications in agriculture (abstract and 'Scope and motivation' state it is a comprehensive review; data availability statement says no data was used). It reports no own data, experiment, survey or validated model run on satellite monitoring, soil moisture tracking or water conservation. Its only material on these topics is secondary (Table 1 literature survey, bullet list on geospatial data citing [40]-[44]).

Review article with no primary data. Mentions of drought prediction and water stress detection (Table 1 entries for Arvind et al., Poblete et al., Achite et al.; text citing [49,50]) are summaries of other work, not the study's own results on satellite monitoring mitigating drought stress.

Review article with no primary data. Statements that AI/precision agriculture maximises yields are general assertions or citations of other work (e.g., bullet on reducing water wastage citing [43,44]; Fig. 5 crop yield map from [106]); no own result on remote sensing and crop production.
